name: Khaled Mosharraf
role: Sector 2 Commander and K Force Leader
contribution: He led Sector 2 operations and later K Force, including key urban and guerrilla actions around Dhaka-linked fronts.
context: Comilla-Dhaka theatre and K Force command, 1971.
impact: His command significantly shaped organized operations in one of the war’s most strategic sectors.
highlight: He helped define the operational character of Sector 2 resistance.
